UCIL located in Jharkhand as per the guidelines and latest S OP of Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA). Pre-Qualification Criteria (PQC)

The Pre-Qualification Criteria for this tender are as follows. The bids of tenderer s which do not fulfill the Qualifying Criteria shall be summarily rejected. PQC – 1 (Financial Capability) (i) Average Annual financial turnover during the last three (03) consecutive fina ncial years, ending 31.03.2025 shall be at least 30% i.e. Rs. 6.89 Lakh of the es timated cost and documental evidences must be attached & supported by the a udited annual accounts of each year. Turnover certificate must contain unique document identification number (UDIN ), Turnover document submitted without UDIN shall be summarily rejected PQC – 2 (Experience) (ii) Institutions having valid CGWA accreditation for preparation of Comprehensi ve hydro geological report (CHR) with modeling. Certificate issued by Accreditat ion board of CGWA shall be submitted. (iii) The bidder should have experience of having completed similar work during the last seven years ending the last day of month previous to one in which the applications are invited. The bidder must attach completion certificate for each work. a. Three similar completed work each costing not less than the amount equal to 40% i.e Rs. 9.18 Lakh of the estimated cost. or b. b. Two similar completed work each costing not less than the amount equal to 50% i.e Rs. 11.48 Lakh of the estimated cost. or c. c. One similar completed work each costing not less than the amount equal to 80% i.e Rs. 18.36 Lakh Note: Similar works means “Study and Preparation of Comprehensive Hydro ge ological Report with modelling for CGWA clearances” for mines only. Institutions must have experience of preparing at least one report for mines of either Metalli ferrous or Coal mine. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
